description: ADMIN ONLY. Create with project, or update id with project OR edits:[{path,content}]. Updates require expected_revision. Returns HTTP 202 job_id and studio_url immediately. Poll gripforge_generation_read; the worker compiles, renders and saves a work revision, then reviews it visually. Completed result includes source_url, preview_url and review. Use generation_read with include_preview to see the actual image. A source conflict fails the job and preserves current work; reread before writing. Validated versions remain unchanged. Editable files are project.json and layers/{id}.vert/.frag.

project.description: Complete editable project JSON. Read gripforge_vfx_project_schema for the format and a working example.

times.description: Render timestamps in seconds. Defaults to anticipation, middle and decay samples.

workspace_id.description: Explicit workspace id. The key must have access to this workspace; never infer another user’s workspace.

name: gripforge_vfx_project_write
title: Create or edit a VFX project
